citations: Genotypes were assigned to known CYP2D6 star alleles per [Supplemental Table S2](#SD1) (online), and then individuals were characterized as poor metabolizers, intermediate metabolizers, normal metabolizers, or ultrarapid metabolizers based on predicted CYP2D6 function as shown in [Supplemental Table S3](#SD1) (online) ([29](#R29),[30](#R30)).
